An isothermal compression meant that the temperature of the gas must be kept constant.

question.html:
A fixed mass of argon gas is in a container, sealed by a movable piston.

The following data is provided:

Number of moles of argon atoms
Pressure
Temperature
Volume

 

(a)   Using the data, estimate the value of the Boltzmann constant. Give your answer to an appropriate number of significant figures.

  [3]

(b)   State the assumption that you made in your calculation in part (a).

  [1]

Using the piston, the argon gas in the container is compressed isothermally.

(c)   Outline why the compression must be slow.

  [2]

Following the compression, the gas expands adiabatically to its initial volume. 

(d)   Explain, with reference to the first law of thermodynamics, whether the temperature of the gas after expanding will be less than, equal to, or greater than .

  [4]
